compare.title: Two households, the same air
compare.lede: Two plans made for the same place and the same air. They differ where the people and their days differ.
compare.sameAir: Both plans were made on the same air:
compare.pickHint: A made-up sample household. Your own household is on the left.
compare.sameWhy: The same air and the same answer for both.
compare.airTitle: The two plans were made on different air
compare.airBody: The air reading changed between the two plans, so they cannot be compared. Compare again.

protected.title: Who needs extra protection
protected.why: It depends on who is at home: children, older people, pregnancy and heart or lung conditions.

moved.title: Outings moved to cleaner hours
moved.why: Only outings whose time can move are moved, and only to hours the forecast shows cleaner.

indoors.title: Kept indoors
indoors.why: Exercise and play move indoors on a severe day for people at risk.

travel.title: Travel changes
travel.why: Swaps follow how each household travels and how far.

largest_cut.title: Largest cut in what is breathed in
largest_cut.why: The largest cut comes from each household's own outings.

indoor_steps.title: Indoor steps
indoor_steps.why: Indoor steps follow each home's rooms, fuel and sources of smoke.
